title: Name UI folders from the crates that already exist

costar.context: The maintainer wants file, folder, and naming rules for scale, grounded in this repository, with SvelteKit plug-in patterns.
costar.objective: Write the naming canon so every UI folder traces to one Rust crate or one jmap module, without renaming the engine.
costar.style: One naming section in the product rule and this plan.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: Rust stays snake_case in crates/. The UI uses the same words in kebab-case. The adapter's map is the path switch in crates/http/src/request.rs.

concerns: Renaming calendar_event to a shorter Svelte name would split the canon.
Putting a SvelteKit app inside crates/ would mix the UI build into the mail workspace.
A catalog id that does not match a jmap folder cannot be traced during review.
context: The workspace is 28 crates under crates/. HTTP dispatch is a match on the first path segment in crates/http/src/request.rs. JMAP features are folders of verb files such as email/get.rs and email/set.rs.
current_state: Package folders are kebab-case. Rust modules are snake_case. The Kit layout names catalog and adapter folders but does not bind them to crates/jmap/src or to /jmap, /dav, /api, /scim, and /auth.
target_design: UI route groups (mail), (calendar), (contacts), (files), (account), and (admin) call src/lib/adapter, which calls only those HTTP paths. Catalog folders use kebab-case of the Rust module: email, mailbox, thread, submission, sieve, vacation, calendar, calendar-event, contact, addressbook, file, quota, identity, principal. Admin features use the file stem under crates/jmap/src/registry/mapping plus crates/scim and crates/directory. component.json id equals the folder name. PascalCase is reserved for the Svelte filename. Proto crates (jmap-proto, dav-proto, http-proto, scim-proto, imap-proto) stay wire types and have no UI folder. maxDiskQuota remains the storage ceiling. The free preset is 2 GB when the UI tree is built. This pass does not create that tree.
changes: Add the Naming section to .cursor/rules/product-boundaries.mdc with the crate map and the HTTP path map.
Leave every Rust file name unchanged.
boundaries: Do not rename crates or Rust modules.
Do not scaffold SvelteKit inside crates/ or the workspace members.
Do not add a license checker that accepts keys.

verification.name: rule-binds-ui-names-to-crates
verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path(r'.cursor/rules/product-boundaries.mdc').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); keys=['calendar_event','calendar-event','crates/http/src/request.rs','/jmap','/dav','/scim','maxDiskQuota','jmap-proto']; missing=[k for k in keys if k not in t]; assert not missing, missing; print('ok')"
verification.proves: The naming canon cites real Rust modules, HTTP paths, the quota field, and a proto crate, and the UI spelling of calendar-event.

verification.name: tree-matches-schemas
verification.proves: This plan and the other modules match their schemas. A missing crate binding fails the first check even if this one passes.
